adrs.title: ADR-0001: One Spring Boot application, domain packages enforced by ArchUnit
ADR-0002: COBOL paragraph → camelCase Java method, original name in Javadoc
ADR-0003: `PIC X(n)` → trimmed `String` with maximum length validation
ADR-0004: `PIC S9(n)V99` / `COMP-3` → `BigDecimal` with explicit scale
ADR-0005: `RoundingMode.HALF_UP` only where COBOL says `ROUNDED`; truncate otherwise
ADR-0006: Level-88 condition names → enum
ADR-0007: COMMAREA → authenticated session context
ADR-0008: `EXEC CICS XCTL` → controller dispatch; `EXEC CICS LINK` / `CALL` → service call
ADR-0009: CICS RESP conditions → HTTP status
ADR-0010: `READ UPDATE` / `REWRITE` → `@Transactional` + `@Version` optimistic locking
ADR-0011: VSAM KSDS → table with primary key; AIX → index
ADR-0012: GDG → dated rows / dated files
ADR-0013: `CALL 'CEE3ABD'` → unchecked `AbendException` with the original code
ADR-0014: Reproduce the baseline clock pin and JCL date parameters in Java
ADR-0015: Batch CLI, DD parameters and JCL condition codes
ADR-0016: Control-M / CA-7 schedule → `nightly-cycle` flow job with in-app cron
ADR-0017: COMMAREA user fields → stateless HS256 JWT; web layer above the domains
ADR-0018: USRSEC passwords stay plain text (COBOL-compatible compare); hashing is a follow-up
ADR-0019: Uniform online error body `{code, field, message}` and `NavigationContext`
ADR-0020: Card numbers masked in lists and logs, opaque card references, USER card scope
ADR-0021: Online report requests run the batch `tranrept` stream asynchronously
ADR-0022: React + Vite SPA per BMS map, served by nginx in front of the API
